name: local-gpu-imagegen
description: Run durable, reviewable Stable Diffusion image generation workflows on the local machine.

interface.shortDescription: Run local image generation with review and recovery.
interface.longDescription: Local GPU Imagegen bundles a Codex skill and MCP server for AUTOMATIC1111-compatible WebUI APIs or Hugging Face Diffusers. Version 0.3 adds durable 1-to-3-round runs, review, recovery, bounded previews, and explicit cleanup while preserving structured diagnostics and the no-hidden-download policy.
defaultPrompt: Use my local GPU to generate an image.
Check whether CUDA image generation is ready.
Create and review a local illustration run.
